lines.text: في معرفة كُسُوف القمر بالحِساب والجَدْوَل ومَعْرِفة أقْدار الكسوف واوْقاته وجهة الظُّلْمة والانجلاء
lines.plain: في معرفة كُسُوف القمر بالحِساب والجَدْوَل ومَعْرِفة أقْدار الكسوف واوْقاته وجهة الظُّلْمة والانجلاء

lines.text: قال اذا اردتَّ أن تعرِف كُسُوف القمر فتفقَّدْ حَرَكة العَرْض الوُسْطَى في الاسْتِقْبالات فإِن
lines.plain: قال اذا اردتَّ أن تعرِف كُسُوف القمر فتفقَّدْ حَرَكة العَرْض الوُسْطَى في الاسْتِقْبالات فإِن

lines.text: كانت فيما بين الحُدُود الكُسُوفيّة المرسومة في صَفْح شُهور الاجْتِماعات والمُقَابَلات فإِنّه قد يُمْكِن أن
lines.plain: كانت فيما بين الحُدُود الكُسُوفيّة المرسومة في صَفْح شُهور الاجْتِماعات والمُقَابَلات فإِنّه قد يُمْكِن أن

lines.text: ينكسِف القمر وإِن زاد على تلك الاقدار او نقَص منها لم يُمْكِنْ أن ينكسِف فإِن كان في المُمْكِن
lines.plain: ينكسِف القمر وإِن زاد على تلك الاقدار او نقَص منها لم يُمْكِنْ أن ينكسِف فإِن كان في المُمْكِن

lines.text: ان ينكسِف فانظُرْ الى حَرَكة العَرْض المعدَّلة لوقت الاستقبال فإِن كانت {ov:شس} دَرَجَة سَوَاءً فالقمر في{mL:10}
lines.plain: ان ينكسِف فانظُرْ الى حَرَكة العَرْض المعدَّلة لوقت الاستقبال فإِن كانت شس دَرَجَة سَوَاءً فالقمر في

lines.text: نَفْس عُقْدَة الرَّأْس وإِن كانت {ov:قف} درجة سَوَاءً فالقمر في نَفْس عُقْدَة الذَّنَب. فإِن زاد على احد
lines.plain: نَفْس عُقْدَة الرَّأْس وإِن كانت قف درجة سَوَاءً فالقمر في نَفْس عُقْدَة الذَّنَب. فإِن زاد على احد

lines.text: هٰذَيْن العَدَدَيْن فقد جاوَز العُقْدة بقَدْر *الزيادة وإِن كان اقلَّ فهو دُونَ العَقْد وبقَدْر النقصان فإِذا{mR:f. 99,v.}
lines.plain: هٰذَيْن العَدَدَيْن فقد جاوَز العُقْدة بقَدْر *الزيادة وإِن كان اقلَّ فهو دُونَ العَقْد وبقَدْر النقصان فإِذا

lines.text: كان القمر في نفْس العَقْد كان الكُسوف اتمَّ ما يكون. وإِن كان بُعْده عن إِحْدَى{n:1} من العُقْدَتَيْن
lines.plain: كان القمر في نفْس العَقْد كان الكُسوف اتمَّ ما يكون. وإِن كان بُعْده عن إِحْدَى من العُقْدَتَيْن

lines.text: اكثرَ من {ov:يب} درجة من أَمَامها او من خَلْفها فإِنّه لا يُمْكِن أن ينكسِف وان كان اقلَّ من ذلك
lines.plain: اكثرَ من يب درجة من أَمَامها او من خَلْفها فإِنّه لا يُمْكِن أن ينكسِف وان كان اقلَّ من ذلك

lines.text: انكسَف وكان كُسوفه على قَدْر بُعْده وقُرْبه من العُقْدَة. فإِن كان وقت الاستقبال ليلًا او قُرْبَ طُلوع{mL:15}
lines.plain: انكسَف وكان كُسوفه على قَدْر بُعْده وقُرْبه من العُقْدَة. فإِن كان وقت الاستقبال ليلًا او قُرْبَ طُلوع

lines.text: الشمس او غُروبها فإِنّ الكسوف يُرَى كلّه او بَعْضه بحَسَب الوقت فإِذا علِمْتَ أنّه ينكسِف ويُرَى
lines.plain: الشمس او غُروبها فإِنّ الكسوف يُرَى كلّه او بَعْضه بحَسَب الوقت فإِذا علِمْتَ أنّه ينكسِف ويُرَى

lines.text: الكُسوف او بَعْضه فأَدْخِلْ حركة العرض المقوَّمة لوقت الاستقبال الى جداول التعديل وخُذْ عرض
lines.plain: الكُسوف او بَعْضه فأَدْخِلْ حركة العرض المقوَّمة لوقت الاستقبال الى جداول التعديل وخُذْ عرض

lines.text: القمر واعرِفْ جِهَته وإِن شِئْتَ فاعرِفْه ببُعْد القَمَر عن العُقْدة والمَعْنَى واحد في الأَمْرَيْن جميعًا فما حصَل
lines.plain: القمر واعرِفْ جِهَته وإِن شِئْتَ فاعرِفْه ببُعْد القَمَر عن العُقْدة والمَعْنَى واحد في الأَمْرَيْن جميعًا فما حصَل

lines.text: عرض القمر [الحقيقيّ لوَسَط الكُسُوف]{n:2} فاحفَظْه ثمّ أَدْخِلْ حاصَّة القمر المصحَّحة لوقت الاستقبال
lines.plain: عرض القمر [الحقيقيّ لوَسَط الكُسُوف] فاحفَظْه ثمّ أَدْخِلْ حاصَّة القمر المصحَّحة لوقت الاستقبال

lines.text: الى جداول التقويم وخُذْ ما تحتها في الجَدْوَل الثالث الذي فيه حِصَص البُعْد فما بلَغ من الدقائق{mL:20}
lines.plain: الى جداول التقويم وخُذْ ما تحتها في الجَدْوَل الثالث الذي فيه حِصَص البُعْد فما بلَغ من الدقائق

lines.text: فاعرِفْ مِقْداره من ستّين فما كان فخُذْ من الخَمْس الدقائق والنِّصْف والرُّبْع التي بها يختَلِف قُطْر القمر
lines.plain: فاعرِفْ مِقْداره من ستّين فما كان فخُذْ من الخَمْس الدقائق والنِّصْف والرُّبْع التي بها يختَلِف قُطْر القمر

lines.text: مِثْلَ ذلك فما حصَل فزِدْه ابدًا على تِسْع وعشرين دقيقة وثلثين{n:3} ثانية التي هي قُطْر القمر في أَرْفَعِ
lines.plain: مِثْلَ ذلك فما حصَل فزِدْه ابدًا على تِسْع وعشرين دقيقة وثلثين ثانية التي هي قُطْر القمر في أَرْفَعِ

notes.text: 1) Cod. احد — 2) Supplevi iuxta Platonis versionem. — 3) Cod. واربعين

observations: L04, L05, L08, L09, L10, L11, L13, L14, L16, L17, L19: long joins (فـإِن at the end of L04 and on L08; فإِنّـه on L05 and L11; the second عُقْـدَة of L08; فـإِذا at the end of L09; إِحْـدَى; اقـلَّ on L11; أنّـه; وخُـذْ on L14; حاصَّـة; مـا, فـما and بلَـغ on L17; ثانيـة and أَرْفَـعِ on L19) are not transcribed; nor the long kāf of حَرَكة (L04, L07), يُمْكِن (L05, L11), يُمْكِنْ and المُمْكِن (L06).

The page begins chapter 43. The heading stands on L01, centred in the larger type (203 to 364 pt). The title fills two lines: L02 (79 to 487 pt), its baseline 46 pt under that of the heading, and L03, centred (214 to 352 pt) and closed by a full stop. The text of the chapter begins on L04, set in by 20.5 pt (it begins at 472 pt), its baseline 52.5 pt under that of L03; L05 to L19 run the full measure (72 to 492 pt). Nallino's line numbers stand in the left margin: 5 beside L03, the second line of the title (its foot 4.0 pt above the baseline), 10 beside L07, 15 beside L12 and 20 beside L17: his grid counts the blank line between the title and the text, so that L04, the first line of the text, is line 7. The folio number «f. 99,v.» stands in the right margin beside L09, where the asterisk stands between بقَدْر and الزيادة. The three notes stand in one line set in (98 to 393 pt), its baseline 28 pt under a rule of 99 pt. A mark of the scan outside the page at the foot is not a margin item; the extent of the note line is measured from its ink.

The heading «الباب الثالث والاربعون» is printed with the ligature of the lām and the alif in والاربعون and carries no signs. The title: كُسُوف: a damma over the kāf and a damma over the sīn (so also in the text, L04); بالحِساب: a kasra under the ḥā'; والجَدْوَل: a fatha high over the ligature of the lām and the jīm (its top 15.8 pt over the baseline), a round sukun over the dāl and a fatha over the wāw; ومَعْرِفة: a fatha over the mīm, a round sukun over the ʿayn and a kasra under the rā' (the first معرفة of the line: no signs); أقْدار: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 3.2 pt, the notched form in both copies) and a round sukun over the two dots of the qāf; واوْقاته: a round sukun over the second wāw; الظُّلْمة: over the ẓā' a shadda with a damma above it in one cluster (4.0 x 6.5 pt) and a round sukun joined to the top of the lām, in both copies; والانجلاء: the hamza on the line. المختلِفة: a kasra under the lām; للبُلدان: a damma over the bā' and no sukun; then the full stop. الآفاق: the madda over the alif of the lām-alif.

L03: دَوَائِر: a fatha over the dāl and a fatha over the wāw; the tooth after the alif is printed bare, without a hamza and without dots, in both copies, and a kasra stands under it (a slanting stroke of 3.6 x 2.2 pt, 5.7 to 7.9 pt under the baseline, of the size and at the height of the kasra of المختلِفة on the same line). The letter of the word is kept, as on p. 88.

L09: هٰذَيْن: over the hā' stands a small upright stroke (1.8 x 3.6 pt, 13.0 to 9.4 pt over the baseline), in both copies: the upright alif, as over the lām of اللّٰه; a fatha over the dhāl, above its dot, and a round sukun over the yā'.

L05: فيما: the two dots of the yā' are joined in one slanting piece (3.2 x 2.2 pt), in both copies; they are not a kasra. L08: under the nūn of فإِن stands a round speck (1.1 x 1.4 pt) in the master scan only; the second copy has nothing there: it is not transcribed.
Numerals in letters, in a smaller type, under bars: L07 {ov:شس} (13.6 pt), 360, with the three dots of the shīn in one cluster under the bar; L08 {ov:قف} (13.2 pt), 180; L11 {ov:يب} (13.1 pt), 12.

Square brackets (L16): Nallino's supplement «الحقيقيّ لوَسَط الكُسُوف», with the reference to note 2 after the closing bracket. The references to notes 1 and 3 stand after إِحْدَى (L10) and after وثلثين (L19).

Final yā': with its two dots in في (L02, L04, L05, L06, L07, L08, L10, L15, L17, L19), الحقيقيّ, الذي, التي (L18, L19) and هي; without dots in الوُسْطَى, على (L06, L08, L12, L19), الى (L07, L14, L17), إِحْدَى, يُرَى, ويُرَى and والمَعْنَى. The hamza stands over its tooth in الدقائق (L17, L18) and شِئْتَ, and on the line in والانجلاء. It stands bare over the alif in أقْدار, أن (L04: 2.9 x 3.6 pt; L05, L06, L11: 2.9 x 3.2 pt) and أنّه (L13: 2.9 x 2.9 pt). The hamza and its kasra stand under the alif in one cluster (3.2-3.6 x 4.3-5.0 pt) in فإِن (L04, L06, L07, L08, L12), فإِنّه (L05, L11), وإِن (L06, L08, L09, L10, L15), فإِذا (L09, L13), إِحْدَى and فإِنّ.

The hamza over the alif with a sign above it, in one cluster: with a fatha in أَمَامها (4.0 x 5.0 pt), فأَدْخِلْ (3.6 x 5.0 pt), الأَمْرَيْن (over the lām-alif, 4.0 x 5.0 pt), أَدْخِلْ (3.6 x 4.7 pt) and أَرْفَعِ (3.6 x 5.0 pt); with a round sukun in الرَّأْس (3.6 x 5.4 pt). سَوَاءً (L07, L08): a fatha over the sīn, a fatha over the wāw and, after the alif, the hamza on the line with the fathatan above it in one cluster (4.0 x 5.8 and 3.6 x 5.8 pt; a notched hamza with two strokes over it in the second copy).

The node: عُقْدَة (twice on L08) and العُقْدَة (L12): a damma over the ʿayn, a round sukun over the two dots of the qāf and a fatha over the dāl; العُقْدة (L09, L15): the damma and the sukun; العَقْد (L09, L10): a fatha over the ʿayn and the sukun; العُقْدَتَيْن (L10): the damma, the sukun, a fatha over the dāl, a fatha over the tā' and a round sukun over the yā'. The eclipse: كُسُوف (L02, L04) and الكُسُوف (L16) with two dammas; الكُسوف (L10, L14) and كُسوفه (L12) with one damma (on L10 it is joined to the top of the upper stroke of the kāf in the master scan and stands just over it in the second copy); الكسوف (L02, L13) with no signs; الكُسُوفيّة (L05) with two dammas and a shadda over the yā'.

حَرَكة (L04, L07): a fatha over the ḥā' and a fatha over the rā'; no fatha over the long kāf, in both places (as on p. 144); حركة (L14): no signs. نَفْس (twice on L08): a fatha over the nūn, above its dot, and a round sukun over the dot of the fā'; نفْس (L10): the sukun only, in both copies.

L04: اردتَّ: over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks). تعرِف: a kasra under the rā'. فتفقَّدْ: over the second qāf, above its two dots, a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks), and a round sukun over the dāl. العَرْض (L04, L07): a fatha over the ʿayn and a round sukun over the rā'; العرض (L14) and عرض (L14, L16): no signs. الوُسْطَى: a damma over the wāw, a round sukun over the sīn and a fatha over the ṭā'. الاسْتِقْبالات: a round sukun over the sīn (a ring in the second copy), a kasra under the tā' and a round sukun over the two dots of the qāf; الاستقبال (L07, L12, L14, L16): no signs.

L05: الحُدُود: a damma high over the ligature of the lām and the ḥā' (its top 17.6 pt over the baseline) and a damma over the first dāl. صَفْح: a fatha over the ṣād and a round sukun over the dot of the fā'. شُهور: a damma over the shīn, above its three dots. الاجْتِماعات: a round sukun high over the jīm (its top 14.0 pt over the baseline) and a kasra under the tā'. والمُقَابَلات: a damma high over the ligature of the lām and the mīm (its top 18.0 pt over the baseline), a fatha over the two dots of the qāf and a fatha over the bā'. فإِنّه (L05, L11): a shadda over the nūn. يُمْكِن (L05, L11): a damma over the yā', a round sukun over the mīm and a kasra under the long kāf; يُمْكِنْ (L06): the same and a round sukun over the nūn; المُمْكِن (L06): a damma high over the ligature of the lām and the mīm, a round sukun over the second mīm and a kasra under the long kāf.
L06: ينكسِف (L06 twice, L07, L11, L13): a kasra under the sīn; انكسَف (L12): a fatha over the sīn. نقَص: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf.

L07: ان (the first word of the line): no hamza; وان (L11): no hamza. فانظُرْ: a damma joined to the top of the stem of the ẓā' and a round sukun over the rā'. المعدَّلة: over the dāl a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks). دَرَجَة: a fatha over the dāl and, over the rā' and the jīm, two fathas joined in one stroke (7.2 x 3.6 pt); درجة (L08, L11): no signs.
L08: الرَّأْس: over the rā' a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks). الذَّنَب: over the dhāl a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks) and a fatha over the nūn; then the full stop.

L09: العَدَدَيْن: a fatha over the ʿayn and over each dāl and a round sukun over the yā'. جاوَز: a fatha over the wāw. بقَدْر and وبقَدْر (L09) and قَدْر (L12): a fatha over the two dots of the qāf and a round sukun over the dāl. اقلَّ (L09, L11): over the lām a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks). دُونَ: a damma over the dāl and a fatha over the nūn.

L10: اتمَّ: over the mīm a shadda with a fatha above it; then ما يكون and the full stop. بُعْده (L10, L12): a damma over the bā' and a round sukun over the ʿayn; ببُعْد (L15) and البُعْد (L17): the same. إِحْدَى: a round sukun over the ḥā' and a fatha over the dāl.

L11: اكثرَ: a fatha over the rā'. أَمَامها: a fatha over the first mīm. خَلْفها: a fatha over the khā', above its dot, and a round sukun joined to the top of the lām in the master scan (a ring apart, just over the lām, in the second copy).

L12: وقُرْبه: a damma over the qāf and a round sukun over the rā'; قُرْبَ: the same and a fatha over the bā'. ليلًا: the fathatan over the lām-alif (3.6 x 3.2 pt); no sukun over the yā'. طُلوع: a damma over the ṭā'.

L13: غُروبها: a damma over the ghayn, above its dot. فإِنّ: a shadda over the nūn. يُرَى and ويُرَى: a damma over the yā' and a fatha over the rā'. كلّه: a shadda over the lām. بَعْضه (L13, L14): a fatha over the bā' and a round sukun over the ʿayn. بحَسَب: a fatha over the ḥā' and over the sīn. علِمْتَ: a kasra under the lām, a round sukun over the mīm and a fatha over the tā'. أنّه: a shadda over the nūn.

L14: فأَدْخِلْ (L14) and أَدْخِلْ (L16): a round sukun over the dāl, a kasra under the khā' and a round sukun over the lām. المقوَّمة: over the wāw a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks). وخُذْ (L14, L17) and فخُذْ (L18): a damma over the khā' and a round sukun over the dhāl.

L15: واعرِفْ, فاعرِفْه and فاعرِفْ (L18): a kasra under the rā' and a round sukun over the fā'. جِهَته: a kasra under the jīm and a fatha over the hā'. شِئْتَ: a kasra under the shīn, the hamza over its tooth with a round sukun above it in one cluster (3.6 x 5.8 pt) and a fatha over the tā'. القَمَر: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf and a fatha over the mīm; the other القمر of the page carry no signs. والمَعْنَى: a fatha high over the ligature of the lām and the mīm, a round sukun over the ʿayn and a fatha over the nūn. الأَمْرَيْن: a round sukun over the mīm, a fatha over the rā' and a round sukun over the yā'. جميعًا: the fathatan. حصَل (L15, L19): a fatha over the ṣād.

L16: الحقيقيّ: a shadda over the last yā'. لوَسَط: a fatha over the wāw and over the sīn. فاحفَظْه: a fatha over the second fā' and a round sukun at the top of the stem of the ẓā'. ثمّ: a shadda over the mīm. حاصَّة: over the ṣād a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks) and no dot over the ḥā', in both copies (for خاصّة). المصحَّحة: over the first ḥā' a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks).

L17: الجَدْوَل: a fatha over the jīm, a round sukun over the dāl and a short fatha over the wāw (2.9 x 1.4 pt). حِصَص: a kasra under the ḥā' and a fatha over the first ṣād. بلَغ: a short fatha over the lām (2.5 x 1.8 pt).

L18: مِقْداره: a kasra under the mīm and a round sukun over the two dots of the qāf. ستّين: a shadda over the tā'. الخَمْس: a fatha over the khā' and a round sukun over the mīm. والنِّصْف: a shadda over the nūn with a kasra under it, and a round sukun over the ṣād. والرُّبْع: over the rā' a shadda with a damma in one cluster (4.0 x 6.8 pt) and a round sukun over the bā'. يختَلِف: a short fatha close over the two dots of the tā' (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under the lām, as in المختَلِفة on pp. 142 and 143. قُطْر (L18, L19): a damma over the qāf and a round sukun at the top of the stem of the ṭā'.

L19: مِثْلَ: a kasra under the mīm, the three dots of the thā' with a round sukun over them in one cluster (3.6 x 6.5 pt; a ring over the dots in the second copy) and a fatha over the lām. فزِدْه: a kasra under the zāy and a round sukun over the dāl. ابدًا: the fathatan. تِسْع: a kasra under the tā' and a round sukun over the sīn. أَرْفَعِ: a round sukun over the rā', a fatha over the fā', above its dot, and a kasra at the left of the bowl of the ʿayn, joined to it in the master scan and apart from it in the second copy.
Notes: one line: «1) Cod. احد — 2) Supplevi iuxta Platonis versionem. — 3) Cod. واربعين». The Arabic words stand in the small type.
